plain_language: A new survey paper ties the AI-safety verification chain into one map. The US safety order deadline is now one day away. Cerebras steady near $199 ahead of Thursday's analyst event.
findings:
Wednesday's signal compresses Monday's training-surface extension and Tuesday's tenant-policy-attestation extension into a single citable end-to-end verification graph and lands the procurement, governance, and product clocks one day deeper into the same Friday May 22 inflection. The day's defining new datum is a Wednesday arxiv release (2605.07891) that adds a consolidation survey to the four-document loader-verification cluster, synthesizing the consolidated 2605.07241 framework plus its 2605.07412 empirical companion plus the 2605.07588 training-surface extension plus Tuesday's 2605.07735 tenant-policy-attestation extension into one end-to-end verification graph spanning training-run checkpoint through agent-loader through tenant-policy gate, with a tabulated composition-overhead table reporting only a marginal incremental overhead on top of the per-surface overheads measured in the four prior companions. Simon Willison characterizes the result as the loader-verification line reaching a settled survey state by mid-week, the four primary papers plus the Wednesday survey now forming a unified five-document reference set the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment commitment can cite as a single coherent end-to-end surface, and andrew.ooo confirms the reproduction harness extends the existing DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index to a single end-to-end run covering all five surfaces. The implementation cohort is wiring the unified surface: vLLM's v0.11.5 development branch folds the tenant-policy-attestation manifest verification hook in alongside Monday's training-surface checkpoint-provenance hook as paving steps on top of the existing five-surface mitigation set, Unsloth wires the manifest as the sixth verification surface directly into the router-only training driver, and the Mistral Workflows six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix conformance suite now runs the manifest check on every conformance pass for a third consecutive weekday green cycle. Both feed the unified loader-verification model ships as framework default by mid-June 2026 prediction (May 16) and the open-source serving stacks signed-checkpoint loading prediction (May 12), carried strong.

The day's most coherent cross-stream pattern is procurement, governance, and product clocks all compressing to T-minus-one against the same Friday May 22 inflection. The CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy moves to its second full operating day with the directive's mandatory-attestation submission portal opening for Thursday-morning intake, the federal-civilian remediation deadline for the n8n CVE-2026-21858 weekday-descent now at T-minus-one business day against a Shadowserver Wednesday day-twenty scan of roughly 1,180 internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances (down from Tuesday's 1,395, the residual unpatched long-tail share easing to about 9 percent), Censys exploitation telemetry holding flat at 1.7x baseline for a third consecutive weekday read consistent with commodity-tier volume settling rather than ramping into the deadline. On the governance leg, the Frontier Model Review Board executive order advances into the fifth calendar day of the ten-business-day classified-annex response clock with the deadline now at T-minus-one business day against the same Friday May 22 expiry: the Office of the Director of National Intelligence files the third substantive submission against the Senate Cyber Subcommittee's classified-annex follow-up question set on top of Tuesday's CISA Director submission and Monday's NIST Director Locascio submission, three of eight witnesses now on record at the midpoint of the response cadence on the steeper side of what the eight-witness slate had projected, and the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee converts Tuesday's posted calendar entry into a formal Wednesday-morning notice of markup for the parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution draft with the markup slot firmed for the back half of next week and a staff memorandum circulated. The OECD GENAI member-state schema-comment submissions clear four-fifths of the named-candidate cohort with the secretariat's schema-comment close keyed to Friday May 29 and the June 2-6 plenary at T-minus-thirteen calendar days, the named-candidate count steps to sixteen as Brunei joins as the next adjacent-track Indo-Pacific signal, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix holds its first-week-of-June general-availability target with the conformance suite green across all six vendors for a third consecutive weekday and the manifest check confirmed running on every pass, and the Anthropic Mythos-Preview gated cohort adds two further Continental European public-sector tenants to reach seventy with the verification harness reproducing the deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail under 55 seconds and the tenant-policy step layered.

Defensive telemetry keeps tightening on the weekday tempo with each consecutive-day counter ticking up one. Sysdig holds the unprotected-estate credential-extraction median at five minutes for a ninth consecutive day against a 5.6-hour Defender-protected window (a 67x gap), Wiz reports the Defender for Cloud quarantine rate on net-new MCP servers ticking from 49 to 50 percent for a tenth consecutive expansion day and the first time the quarantine line has reached the half-of-net-new threshold, Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy edges from roughly 2,455 to roughly 2,490 enterprise tenants with Akamai SkyAtlas near 1,430, and CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI's four-orchestrator managed-visibility composition nudges from 91 to 92 percent — the highest cross-vendor visibility reading the telemetry has carried. The agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE wave holds flat at eleven catalogued instances into the third business-week day, with the loader-verification storyline now anchored to a settled five-document academic reference set plus a published federal directive at its second operating day plus a mid-June default-shipment commitment carrying the optional sixth surface, giving any framework releasing the default ahead of mid-June a fully-pinned alignment story per Simon Willison.

The markets stream resumes weekday motion into a T-minus-one analyst-day catalyst without yet resolving. Cerebras CBRS opens Wednesday with the analyst-day eve trading session as the May 21 Alphabet analyst day steps to T-minus-one calendar day, the five-desk spread carrying unchanged into the third trading day inside the same roughly $185-to-$235 band — Bernstein's $185 floor, Morgan Stanley's $192 with the upside-scenario probability ticking from 42 to 43 percent, Wells Fargo Securities at $208, Jefferies at $225, and UBS at $205 — with institutional-buyside cumulative net position edging from roughly 38 to roughly 39 percent of float as desks added small incremental long exposure into the analyst-day eve, the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU holding its late-Q2 2026 window, and the Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion stepping into the back half of the 10-21 day execution window. The six-desk Mag-7 preview cohort nudges the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability from 89 to 90 percent — a further one-point uptick and the first time the cohort consensus has cleared the 90-percent threshold — against the unchanged Friday SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter as the settled disclosure-precedent input, with the VentureBeat aggregation reiterating cohort consensus that Microsoft, Meta, and AWS follow with their own AI Services revenue breakouts in their fiscal Q3 2026 prints and the cohort now treating the Alphabet analyst-day script — released to selected sell-side desks under the standard pre-print briefing protocol — as the next concrete read on the precedent-conformance language. Tenstorrent's Corp Fin first-round comment-letter response moves to its 13-business-day mark inside the staff-review interval with the second-round letter expected late Thursday or Friday and the early-August public-filing target holding, SambaNova's bookrunner roster stays at six toward a final-week-of-June confidential submission, and AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book advances from near 10.55GW to near 10.7GW with a fresh weekday sovereign-cloud commitment — the third new commitment of the business week and the highest weekly cadence the book has carried since the program opened. Tenstorrent Wormhole Galaxy-rack capacity advances from roughly 187 to roughly 198 racks against the 280-rack first-half target — about 71 percent fulfilled (up from about 67 percent), the first time the capacity-fulfillment curve has crossed the 70-percent threshold — with additions spread across CoreWeave and Lambda Labs in North America plus a third Asia-Pacific increment splitting between Yotta Labs India and CDS Japan plus a third European sovereign-cloud increment going to Outscale France and Atlante Cloud Italy. Two dormant longshots remain quiet on Wednesday — the foundation-labs audited monthly revenue prediction (Apr 30) and the LLM-tooling-plus-Linux-kernel CVE-chain prediction (May 2) — neither getting the audited monthly-revenue cadence nor an IR-firm kernel-chain post-mortem each specifically calls for.
